# GitHub

> > GitHub is the world's leading AI-powered developer platform for version control, collaboration, and software development, serving 180M+ developers with tools like GitHub Copilot, Actions, Codespaces, and Advanced Security.

GitHub combines Git version control with cloud-based collaboration, CI/CD automation, code security scanning, and AI-assisted development. The platform includes specialized tools for education (GitHub Classroom), package management (GitHub Packages), code analysis (CodeQL), and community engagement through discussions and open source sponsorship.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- GitHub Advanced Security
- Git version control
- Code security and Dependabot
- Repository management
- CI/CD automation
- Collaborative coding
- Pull requests and code review
- GitHub CLI and Desktop
- GitHub Pages
- Open source collaboration
- Developer workflows
- Cloud development environments

## Getting Started

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com): GitHub homepage featuring Copilot, Actions, and collaboration platform
- [About GitHub](https://github.com/about): Company overview with platform stats: 180M+ developers, 420M+ repositories
- [GitHub Features](https://github.com/features): Product features: Codespaces, Copilot, Actions, and security tools overview
- [Get Started with GitHub Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started): Documentation landing page with quickstart guides and product overview
- [About GitHub and Git](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey/about-github-and-git): Beginner guide explaining GitHub platform and Git version control basics
- [Hello World Tutorial](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey/hello-world): Introductory tutorial covering pull requests, branches, and commits
- [Start Your Journey](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey): Beginner's guide to GitHub basics, account setup, and profile creation

## Documentation

- [GitHub Docs](https://docs.github.com): Documentation hub for GitHub products, APIs, and developer resources
- [About Repositories](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/creating-and-managing-repositories/about-repositories): Repository basics: ownership, collaboration, and terminology guide
- [About Releases](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/releasing-projects-on-github/about-releases): Git tags, release creation, and software packaging documentation
- [Git and GitHub Learning Resources](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey/git-and-github-learning-resources): Curated learning resources including ProGit, Pluralsight, and GitHub Skills

## Git Version Control

- [Git Basics](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/git-basics): Git setup guide covering configuration, credentials, and remote repos
- [Set Up Git](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/git-basics/set-up-git): Git installation and configuration tutorial with GitHub authentication
- [Git Guides](https://github.com/git-guides): Comprehensive Git guide covering commands, workflow, and best practices

## Developer Tools & Products

- [GitHub Organization Profile](https://github.com/github): GitHub organization profile with contribution stats and open source projects
- [CodeQL](https://codeql.github.com): Semantic code analysis engine for vulnerability detection and queries
- [GitHub Classroom](https://classroom.github.com): Education platform for automated assignment management and grading

## Support & Community

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://github.com/frequently-asked-questions): FAQ covering platform basics, pricing, security, and Git vs GitHub
- [GitHub Support](https://support.github.com): GitHub support portal sign-in for customer assistance and help
- [Community Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions): GitHub Community discussions featuring Copilot challenges and code security

- [Trending Repositories](https://github.com/trending): Daily trending repositories featuring AI projects and open source tools

- [Leadership](https://github.com/about/leadership): Executive team profiles and GitHub leadership bios
